**In one line**: Local station KCENTV reports the rock trucks rolling through downtown Temple, Texas, are hauling material for a $470 million OpenAI data center.

### Key points
- KCENTV traced the destination of rock trucks moving through downtown Temple and linked them to an OpenAI data center construction site.
- The project is reported to be worth roughly $470 million.
- The added truck traffic on downtown roads has become a point of local concern.

### Why it matters
It's a reminder that the AI boom isn't only cloud and model news — it increasingly shows up as physical strain on local roads, construction, and neighborhoods. Large AI data center builds are starting to reshape daily life in the smaller cities that host them.
